title: SHOCKING DNA TEST
description:
Thank you 23andMe for sponsoring this video.  Get your 23andMe kit here: http://www.23andMe.com/haley

My background is full of different ancestors from all over the world, or so my family thinks! My grandparents on my paternal side are Irish and Croatian, and my mother's side is full filipino. Taking the 23andMe test will show my family and I for certain where our bloodlines are from. We might find a few surprises in there, just like Sophie's tale to tell.
